content: Russell Crowe and Paul Bettany both have new shows out so F— it, we're doing MASTER & COMMANDER: THE FAR SIDE OF THE WORLD! Do you want to see a guillotine in Piccadilly? Want to call that raggedy-ass Napoleon your king? You want your children to sing the "La Marseillaise?" Then watch this Honest Trailer!
